These two compact pages are trimmed from Berlin's public ALKIS building WFS
response for `bezeich='AX_Gebaeude' AND BBOX(geom,391600,5817000,393600,5818600)`,
requested with `COUNT=2` and sorted by `uuid` on 2026-10-18. The fixture count
and next links are reduced to four features for offline pagination tests. One
provider MultiPolygon geometry is represented as a Polygon to cover the other
supported GeoJSON polygon type. Coordinates and property values are public
source data; tests can mutate copies without changing these fixtures.
